caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with chashu pork, a halved soft-boiled egg, shredded cabbage, and green onions. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
The chashu pork is a round, browned slice with a slightly crispy surface and visible marbling.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange yolk surrounded by a firm white, with a slightly textured surface.
Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate swirling pattern and raised rim, glossy finish, ornate detailing along the edge.
